load_fsdp_model: load a model with optional FSDP support using safetensors weights and mixed precision policy
shard_model: shard a model with FSDP using the PyTorch Distributed fully_shard API based on shard conditions
load_model_from_full_model_state_dict: convert a full state dict into a sharded state dict and load it into an FSDP or normal model
dequantize_fp8_weights: auto-dequantize FP8 checkpoint weights to higher precision using weight scales from the state dict
format_dtype_mismatch_summary: format a summary of dtype mismatches between checkpoint and target tensors with example parameter names
